name: swe-flow
description: LLM authoring companion to the govkit governance engine. Skills drive the SDLC chain — govkit-adopt (get govkit into a repo first: greenfield `govkit init` scaffold vs `init --adopt` migrating an existing prose corpus, decided from evidence on disk, never guessing unsourced metadata), work-breakdown (slice large work into shippable vertical cuts first), goal-define, api-designer, data-model, and spec-author (PRD/RFC/ADR/US) — plus workflow-author (scaffold reusable .claude/workflows/*.js orchestration), working-discipline (trigger-gated thinking checkpoints that cut agent error and escalation), distill-learnings (the R7 learning loop: distill the gate journal + escape log into proposal-only guardrail changes), substance-judge (the keyed Layer-3 substance evaluation: pinned anchors, cross-model agreement, deepeval-compatible records — RFC-0019; selftest-gated per RFC-0020 — the judge proves itself on calibrate + a ranking probe or refuses to judge), spec-red-team (the keyed adversarial doc red-team: steelman then attack, falsifiable failure modes, one kill criterion — RFC-0022), and gate-close (the Tier-2 orchestrator for the gate loop — PROPOSE → VERIFY → RECONCILE → RED-TEAM → RATIFY, one evidence-backed ratification packet per gate, with a Live verify-for-real station at slice/release close — RFC-0025). Eleven plugin-namespaced role agents author and score the chain and the loop: Author analyst/architect/drafter/implementer/test-author, Score reviewer/red-teamer/verifier/judge, Upkeep doc-keeper/distiller. Domain modelling moved to the sibling `ddd-flow` plugin in v0.11.0 — the two meet at the `docs/domain/` artifact, not an import. Authors artifacts and orchestration, calls `npx govkit verify`; never embeds the deterministic gate.
